source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeCachePartitionSubclassEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Cache.OrgPartition orgPart = Cache.Org.getPartition('local.subclass'); orgPart.put('one', 'A'); orgPart.put('two', 'B', Cache.Visibility.ALL); orgPart.put('ttl', 'C', 60); orgPart.put('full', 'D', 60, Cache.Visibility.NAMESPACE, false); System.assert(orgPart.contains('one')); Map<String, Boolean> orgContains = orgPart.contains(new Set<String>{'one', 'missing'}); System.assertEquals(true, orgContains.get('one')); System.assertEquals(false, orgContains.get('missing')); Map<String, Object> orgValues = orgPart.get(new Set<String>{'one', 'two'}); System.assertEquals('A', (String) orgValues.get('one')); System.assertEquals('B', (String) orgValues.get('two')); System.assertEquals('A', (String) orgPart.get('one')); System.assertEquals(null, orgPart.get(Type.forName('String'), 'missing')); System.assert(orgPart.getKeys().contains('ttl')); System.assertEquals(4, orgPart.getNumKeys()); System.assert(orgPart.getCapacity() > 0); System.assert(orgPart.isAvailable()); System.assertEquals('local.subclass', orgPart.getName()); System.assertEquals(0, orgPart.getAvgGetSize()); System.assertEquals(0, orgPart.getAvgGetTime()); System.assertEquals(0, orgPart.getAvgValueSize()); System.assertEquals(0, orgPart.getMaxGetSize()); System.assertEquals(0, orgPart.getMaxGetTime()); System.assertEquals(0, orgPart.getMaxValueSize()); System.assertEquals(0, orgPart.getMissRate()); System.assertEquals('local.subclass.one', orgPart.createFullyQualifiedKey('local', 'subclass', 'one')); System.assertEquals('local.subclass', orgPart.createFullyQualifiedPartition('local', 'subclass')); orgPart.validatePartitionName('subclass'); orgPart.validateKey(false, 'one'); orgPart.validateKeyValue(false, 'one', 'A'); orgPart.validateKeys(false, new Set<String>{'one', 'two'}); orgPart.validateKeys(false, new List<String>{'one', 'two'}); System.assertEquals(null, orgPart.remove(Type.forName('String'), 'missing')); System.assertEquals('A', (String) orgPart.remove('one')); Cache.Partition baseOrg = orgPart; Map<String, Boolean> baseContains = baseOrg.contains(new Set<String>{'two'}); System.assertEquals(true, baseContains.get('two')); Map<String, Object> baseValues = baseOrg.get(new Set<String>{'two'}); System.assertEquals('B', (String) baseValues.get('two')); baseOrg.validateKeys(false, new List<String>{'two'}); Cache.SessionPartition sessionPart = Cache.Session.getPartition('local.subclass'); sessionPart.put('one', 'SA'); sessionPart.put('two', 'SB', Cache.Visibility.ALL); sessionPart.put('ttl', 'SC', 60); sessionPart.put('full', 'SD', 60, Cache.Visibility.NAMESPACE, false); System.assert(sessionPart.contains('one')); Map<String, Boolean> sessionContains = sessionPart.contains(new Set<String>{'one', 'missing'}); System.assertEquals(true, sessionContains.get('one')); System.assertEquals(false, sessionContains.get('missing')); Map<String, Object> sessionValues = sessionPart.get(new Set<String>{'one', 'two'}); System.assertEquals('SA', (String) sessionValues.get('one')); System.assertEquals('SB', (String) sessionValues.get('two')); System.assertEquals('SA', (String) sessionPart.get('one')); System.assertEquals(null, sessionPart.get(Type.forName('String'), 'missing')); System.assert(sessionPart.getKeys().contains('ttl')); System.assertEquals(4, sessionPart.getNumKeys()); System.assert(sessionPart.getCapacity() > 0); System.assert(sessionPart.isAvailable()); System.assertEquals('local.subclass', sessionPart.getName()); System.assertEquals(0, sessionPart.getAvgGetSize()); System.assertEquals(0, sessionPart.getAvgGetTime()); System.assertEquals(0, sessionPart.getAvgValueSize()); System.assertEquals(0, sessionPart.getMaxGetSize()); System.assertEquals(0, sessionPart.getMaxGetTime()); System.assertEquals(0, sessionPart.getMaxValueSize()); System.assertEquals(0, sessionPart.getMissRate()); System.assertEquals('local.subclass.one', sessionPart.createFullyQualifiedKey('local', 'subclass', 'one')); System.assertEquals('local.subclass', sessionPart.createFullyQualifiedPartition('local', 'subclass')); sessionPart.validatePartitionName('subclass'); sessionPart.validateKey(false, 'one'); sessionPart.validateKeyValue(false, 'one', 'SA'); sessionPart.validateKeys(false, new Set<String>{'one', 'two'}); sessionPart.validateKeys(false, new List<String>{'one', 'two'}); System.assertEquals(null, sessionPart.remove(Type.forName('String'), 'missing')); System.assertEquals('SA', (String) sessionPart.remove('one')); } }
